notes:
Summary: enterprise health-tech vendor, builds clinical documentation search across multiple hospital systems. Main pain: large index scale + strict PHI controls; current search is slow and returns low-precision results for older notes. Wants hybrid RAG: embeddings + rerank for high-precision answers.

Key requirements (customer language / shorthand):
- "High-volume index": ~120M docs initially, expect 2-3x growth year 1.
- Embeddings: prefer 1536-d vectors or equivalent; open to float16/8-bit quantized options to reduce storage.
- Latency SLOs: 95th <= 150ms for vector fetch + rerank cold; target p50 < 40ms for hosted paths. Realistic POC target: end-to-end < 400ms for clinical QA (fetch+rerank+gen).
- Throughput: peak 800 qps for internal clinical assistant; typical 200 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.01/query (avg, across embedding + vdb + rerank); willing to trade a bit for reliability.
- Reranking: cross-encoder on top-50 results because downstream precision critical for clinicians.
- PHI controls: absolutely required BAA, per-request audit logging, field-level retention policies, ability to keep PII/PHI in private VPC until explicit redaction.
- Networking: customer must be able to peer Redwood control plane to their VPC (or run Private). No internet egress of raw PHI allowed.
- Key management: HSM-backed KMS, customer-managed keys preferred.
- Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 required; working toward HITRUST but not mandatory for initial POC.

POC scope & metrics:
- Ingest a 10M-document slice (stratified across EHR vendors) and run full pipeline: embeddings -> ANN -> rerank -> user query latency measurement.
- Measure: 95p latency, p50 latency, cost-per-query, precision@5 on curated clinical QA set, failure-rate under burst.
- Expected deliverables: latency/cost dashboard, audit-log sample, security runbook for VPC peering and KMS.

What we learned so far / concerns:
- Customer's EHR export cadence (near-real-time vs nightly) will change caching strategy. Need ability to invalidate/partial-reindex.
- Vendor connector: their vendor's API throttles large bulk exports; may need an interim S3 staging pipeline. That affects ingest time and total cost.
- Reranker cost: cross-encoder at top-50 is compute-heavy. Customer asked for Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantized cross-encoder, distillation, hybrid CPU/GPU serving).

Sales chatter / quotes:
- "We can't have PHI leave our VPC in plaintext" (Head of IT) -> strong push for Private or VPC-enabled Dedicated.
- Legal: "BAA + turn-key audit log ingestion into our SIEM is required before procurement."

Next steps:
- Finish 2-week POC (start date 2026-03-11) with 10M doc slice. SE to run rerank perf tests and produce cost-per-query baseline.
- Security to provide detailed network diagram for peering and KMS flow. Redwood infra to prepare HSM-KMS integration checklist.
- Jordan to coordinate legal for BAA draft; target signature by 2026-04-15.

Linked artifacts: pricing deck & POC runbook in Drive, two Fireflies transcripts (FF-2026-001234, FF-2026-001289) for demo notes, Jira INF-1123 tracking VPC peering config.
